scope: Visual interpretation of the unchanged first-run evidence. No reference, ROI, threshold, model, runtime or original score was changed.

observations.assessment: Correctly read VAT amount. The center of the merged line lies above the frozen field ROI. The original negative score is a measurement limitation, not an OCR omission.

Magnified publisher-binarized source has visible upper and lower ink marks at the separator in both amounts. The reference records a conventional numeric value. The exact separator cannot be confidently adjudicated as a model error. No source pixels or reference bytes were altered.

BANK is visible on a neighboring terminal slip. The predicted combined line intersects the merchant ROI and therefore includes this source word in the score. There are also genuine character-class and hyphen differences within the merchant name. The extra word is not invented text.

The correct 39.99 is present separately and passes the numeric field test, but the no-cash caption is incorrectly associated with 10.00. Region numeric presence alone does not prove label/value alignment.

The unchanged row checker removes empty cells before comparing, so correctly located 427 and 25 also receive a negative result after earlier dashes disappear. The supplemental column count keeps empty cells; it still rejects all five missing dashes and four misplaced numeric values.
